definition: a small block used to start a fire
description: An old black wood-burning stove stands with its door open in a dim cottage room. Inside, a small white firelighter cube burns under a pile of kindling sticks and split logs, and its flame grows taller and brighter as the sticks catch fire, with sparks and thin smoke rising. On the stone hearth in front lie an opened box of white firelighter cubes with crumbs around it, worn leather gloves and a small brush and dustpan. A basket of birch logs stands beside the stove under a window.
